subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: Should maintainers run and capture a live macOS Chrome 148+ `profile=user` repro before allowing any new fix PR for the remaining all-page-tool timeouts?
rationale: Current source and related merged PRs prove only partial diagnostic and timeout improvements; deciding the next code path requires live evidence about whether the failure is OpenClaw-owned or upstream Chrome DevTools MCP behavior.

options.title: Run live macOS repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open, capture `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate` on current main with Chrome remote debugging enabled, then scope a fix from the observed failure boundary.

options.title: Limit OpenClaw to diagnostics
options.body: If live proof shows Chrome DevTools MCP cannot support this Chrome permission-gated mode reliably, narrow the OpenClaw change to fast errors, doctor/docs guidance, and managed-profile fallback guidance.

options.title: Sponsor a larger browser-session path
options.body: If signed-in browser control must work beyond Chrome MCP limits, route the work through an explicit browser-session driver or plugin/API design instead of a small repair PR.

recommendation.title: Run live macOS repro first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, capture `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate` on current main with Chrome remote debugging enabled, then scope a fix from the observed failure boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this issue and has already carried related Chrome MCP fixes and landing decisions.
